theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pc_regular_part_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid n → ℤ), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet A → Measurable g → IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ)) A → MeasurableSet {u | u ∈ A ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ H u ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H u) ∧ g u ≠ 0} ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IntegrableOn (fun u => (g u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) A ∧ ∫ u in A, (g u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = ∫ u in {u | u ∈ A ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ H u ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H u) ∧ g u ≠ 0}, (g u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (H u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
